title: Prepare, run and review AlphaFold 3 biomolecular-complex predictions
description: Build versioned official AlphaFold 3 inputs for proteins, nucleic acids and ligands, connect an approved local inference runtime without bundling model weights, audit ranked mmCIF and confidence outputs, and export confidence figures and replot tables.
questions: Which AlphaFold 3 complex samples and chain-pair hypotheses remain interpretable after identity, license, confidence, clash and output-integrity review?
preconditions: Codex can establish non-commercial eligibility, current AlphaFold 3 terms, approved model weights, versioned databases, sufficient Linux GPU resources, and immutable entity identities before local inference.
assumptions: Every sequence, chain ID, modification, CCD ligand, SMILES ligand, covalent context and model seed describes the intended molecular system.

quality_gates.description: Require unique chain IDs, bounded valid sequences, explicit ligand identity and a closed official AlphaFold 3 input dialect.
Record the current code, model-weight and output terms plus runtime, database and weight provenance before inference.
Reconcile all seeds and samples, ranking scores, pTM, ipTM, chain and chain-pair confidence, clashes, mmCIF models and documented confidence files.
Export confidence and structural figure panels as PDF, SVG and 600-dpi PNG with source tables, labels, legends and model-confidence semantics.

limitations: The repository does not bundle AlphaFold 3 model weights or reference databases and cannot grant rights beyond their current terms.
AlphaFold 3 outputs are theoretical predictions and do not establish binding, affinity, kinetics, function, mechanism or clinical validity.
This release validates input generation and output auditing; full local inference additionally requires an approved compatible GPU runtime, weights and databases.

version_differences.description: The adapter emits the documented AlphaFold 3 JSON dialect and reads documented ranking, summary confidence and mmCIF outputs.
version_differences.required_action: Revalidate entity fields, dialect version, output names and confidence semantics after every AlphaFold 3 release.

version_differences.description: Matplotlib exports confidence summaries in vector and high-resolution raster formats.
version_differences.required_action: Reload every figure and retain its source table and style version.

dependencies.name: python
dependencies.purpose: Prepare requests and audit outputs without embedding model assets.

concept_sources: Project-owned input builder, output auditor and confidence renderer.

code_templates.purpose: Prepare the official input dialect, connect an approved runtime, parse outputs and render confidence figures.

template_sections.purpose: Prepare, optionally execute, and review an AlphaFold 3 biomolecular complex job.
required_logic: Validate molecular identity and terms, generate official JSON, execute only in an approved runtime, reconcile confidence outputs, and render publication figures.

parameter_rules.selection_rule: Use prepare mode for portable input, parse-existing for supplied outputs, and local inference only with approved weights, databases and GPU runtime.
parameter_rules.validation_rule: Block inference or interpretation when terms, molecular identity, runtime provenance, confidence files or chain-pair scope are unresolved.

preflight_checks: Verify current terms, non-commercial eligibility, entity identity, chain IDs, seeds, modifications, ligand representation, databases, weights and GPU runtime.
postflight_checks: Reconcile all seeds and samples, reload ranking and confidence files, verify mmCIF and figure exports, and bind every digest.
forbidden_actions: Do not bundle or redistribute AlphaFold 3 weights or imply rights beyond the current terms.
Do not treat pTM, ipTM, ranking score or a rendered complex as binding or functional proof.
Do not automate the public AlphaFold Server through an undocumented interface.
